result.text: OS met: median 15.3 vs 11.3 months, HR 0.62 (95% CI 0.52, 0.74; p<0.001). rPFS met: median 8.7 vs 3.4 months, HR 0.40 (95% CI 0.31, 0.52; p<0.001).

citations.quote: The primary endpoint of OS was met, with patients randomized to receive ^{177}\text{Lu}-PSMA-617 having prolonged OS (median estimate 15.3 months) compared to BSC/BSoC (median estimate 11.3 months), HR 0.62 (95% CI: 0.52, 0.74, p<0.001).

The primary endpoint of BICR assessed rPFS was also met, with patients randomized to receive ^{177}\text{Lu}-PSMA-617 plus BSC/BSoC having prolonged rPFS (median estimate 8.7 months) compared to BSC/BSoC (median estimate 3.4 months), HR 0.40 (95% CI: 0.31, 0.52, p<0.001).

citations.quote: 4241-1 Conduct an integrated safety analysis to further characterize the long term outcome of the known serious risk of myelosuppression, renal failure, xerostomia and xerophthalmia and their complications; the potential serious signals of secondary malignancies including myelodysplastic syndrome and acute myeloid leukemia (MDS/AML); and other serious adverse reactions in patients receiving lutetium (^{177}\text{Lu}) vipivotide tetraxetan in the VISION study and its sub-study, Trial CAAA617C12301 (NCT04720157), Trial CAAA617B12302 (NCT04689828) and other clinical trials as appropriate.

requirement.text: PMR 4241-2: Conduct a clinical trial to determine kidney biodistribution, dosimetry, pharmacokinetics, and safety of lutetium (177Lu) vipivotide tetraxetan and assess the potential for higher drug exposure and increased serious toxicities in patients with moderate and severe renal impairment.

citations.quote: 4241-2 Conduct a clinical trial to determine the kidney biodistribution, dosimetry, pharmacokinetics, and safety of lutetium (^{177}\text{Lu}) vipivotide tetraxetan and assess the potential for higher drug exposure and the resultant risk of increased serious toxicities in patients with moderate and severe renal impairment.
